sites.name: Asterion Anchorage
sites.lore: Home port of the Longhaul. Independent cartographers trade verified surveys here.

sites.name: Meridian Exchange
sites.lore: A bright ring of habitable modules built around an abandoned fusion foundry.

sites.name: Farwatch Observatory
sites.lore: The last inhabited outpost before the deep array. Its archivists buy discoveries, not rumors.

sites.name: Glasswake Belt
sites.lore: Silicate fragments carry parallel fracture lines. This field was once a single engineered body.

sites.name: Kestrel Wreck
sites.lore: The missing surveyor's black box contains a star map older than any inhabited colony.

sites.name: Singing Array
sites.lore: Six suspended resonators repeat the same interval. The signal is a coordinate, not a distress call.

sites.name: Asterion IV
sites.lore: Copper-green oceans and silver cloud bands. Orbital spectroscopy reveals a thriving microbial biosphere.

sites.name: Nacre Moon
sites.lore: A pale fractured moon. Buried superconducting seams resonate with the Singing Array.

sites.name: Pilgrim Vault
sites.lore: The vault protects a crystalline archive. Its final entry charts a route beyond the heliopause.

sites.name: Helios Beacon
sites.lore: An ancient navigation seed awakens in the Longhaul's hold. The Reach is only the beginning.

sites.name: Cinder
sites.lore: Volcanic plains preserve the first harmonic of the Kestrel star map. The archive was a network, not a monument.

sites.name: Pelagos
sites.lore: A global ocean echoes the same carrier wave. Beneath the clouds, ancient buoys once carried voices between worlds.

sites.name: Borealis
sites.lore: An icebound relay contains the final coordinate key. Its last transmission names Pilgrim as a refuge for memory.

sites.name: Vesper
sites.lore: Amber storm bands wrap a gas giant at the edge of the Reach. A quiet beacon repeats a farewell in a thousand languages.

sites.name: Kepler-442b
sites.lore: The opening survey world. Forest uplands, basalt ridges and warm shallows surround the Longhaul's first landing site.

sites.name: Eidolon
sites.lore: A fractured violet world with crystalline ridges and ancient survey markers.

sites.name: Solis Dune
sites.lore: Amber mesas and wind-carved dunes trace the long migration of an extinct inland sea.
